independence.note: The single-maintainer policy makes reviewer independence advisory; remote CI and latest-head Codex review remain separate shipping gates.

review_scope: route request policy and metadata opt-in
complete, failed, and contradictory route observations
future task dependencies and evidence claims
resolved_during_review: Separated evaluator repetitions from per-request router attempts.
Allowed failed and incomplete runs to retain reconciled failed attempts without a selected provider.
Required observed provider names and canonical slugs to match the reviewed route.
residual_risks: The V1-06 adapter must parse additive OpenRouter metadata permissively while projecting only strict durable fields.
Cache hits omit router metadata and must remain incomplete for recommendation evidence.
